_comment: Derived from extras/verification_manifest.jsonl as published with the dataset.
It records every verified row that does NOT come back clean when the original
checker is re-run over the published parquet. verify.py re-downloads the manifest,
re-derives this file from it, and fails if the two disagree.

reasons.note: upstream unit test is nondeterministic: observed failing on at least one of three re-runs and passing on the others
stored gold and boxed answer differ only in LaTeX inline-math delimiters; verify_core.normalize does not strip them, so this row fails the re-check every time. Same value, different string.
all ten upstream asserts fail deterministically on re-execution in a current Python
